title: latency_ms output always returns 0
description:
File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/tx_queue.h
Line: 175

Line 175 documents latency_ms as 'time packet spent in queue' but the implementation (tx_queue.c:354-366) always sets *latency_ms = 0 with a comment admitting it's a placeholder. The documented functionality does not work.
